children: Oslo, Norway — September 14, 2026 — Lokotech Group AS today announced that its SPDU has completed pre-certification testing, marking a key milestone ahead of full regulatory certification. The final iteration of the first-generation SPDU will be submitted for formal certification.

The initial sample batch is now fully booked as commercial samples. Lokotech confirms that production and delivery planning for this first batch are proceeding on schedule. Clients can expect shipment to start within four to six weeks.

With the first batch fully allocated, Lokotech is now taking interest for its next production batch. Miners and hosting clients interested in securing SPDU units are encouraged to contact Lokotech's sales team directly at sales@lokotech.no for availability, lead times, and pricing.
